title: Protected verifier submission
description: Contract EFAH-CONTRACT-001 v1.1 section 17.2. The candidate system may submit ONLY these four fields. additionalProperties is false so a fifth field is a validation error on both sides of the seam, not something the verifier silently ignores.

artifact_or_commit_identifier.description: Exact candidate commit SHA or artifact digest. GATE-D2-19 requires the visible, hidden, and mutant lanes to carry the same value.

allowed_runtime_inputs.description: Inputs the evaluation may use at runtime. Never fixtures, expectations, or oracle configuration.

evaluation_request_id.description: Correlation identifier. Echoed back in the result.

required_contract_or_oracle_version.description: The contract or oracle version the candidate believes it is judged against. A verifier running a different version returns UNVERIFIABLE rather than judging against the wrong one.
